description.html: These blue plastic tweezers are a lightweight tool for feeding smaller animals and simple terrarium jobs. As the picture shows, the tips are serrated, so they hold an insect or a bit of food securely.

Plastic is softer than metal, so the tweezers are gentle on the animal if it bites the tip and on the food, such as crickets or worms you do not want to crush. That makes them a good choice for juveniles, small geckos, frogs and spiders.

They suit keepers who feed smaller species or are just learning to tong-feed. For larger lizards and snakes, and for thawed prey, longer metal tweezers that keep your hand further from the animal are a better choice.

After use, wash the tweezers with warm water and detergent and let them dry. Do not expose them to high temperatures, and replace them if the tips get damaged or an arm cracks. Metal tweezers and other accessories are in our equipment range.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
